# EdenCORP

> Eden is a custom workflow automation agency for organizations.

Eden provides custom development, integration, consulting, and support through individual proposals and contracts.
Website design and executive dashboards are examples of its broad workflow automation scope.
Project scope and pricing are agreed individually.
PRISM's displayed activity and performance figures are simulations, not measured customer results.
The links below lead to public web pages.

## Agency and inquiries

- [Home](https://www.edencorp.org/): EdenCORP's public website.
- [About](https://www.edencorp.org/about): Background on EdenCORP.
- [Contact](https://www.edencorp.org/contact): Discuss a workflow automation project.
- [Orchard](https://www.edencorp.org/orchard): Offering catalog, including concepts marked coming soon.
- [PRISM](https://www.edencorp.org/prism): Campus automation offering with simulated displays.

## Workflow tool guides

- [Zapier vs Make](https://www.edencorp.org/compare/zapier-vs-make): Compare workflow tool choices.
- [n8n vs Zapier](https://www.edencorp.org/compare/n8n-vs-zapier): Compare hosting and workflow ownership.
- [Zapier alternatives](https://www.edencorp.org/alternatives/zapier): Consider tools or custom automation services.
